bug.title: ctx.bars' lookback counts rows across the whole multi-symbol frame, so lookback=N gives each symbol about N/universe rows, and the prompt's own example returns constant zeros on a real universe
bug.symptoms:
MarketWindow.bars(freq, lookback=N) returns the trailing N rows of the whole oldest-first frame. Every caller, including the prompt's own example, reads it as the trailing N candles per symbol.
On the real snapshot, about 23–40 symbols per date, a 20-to-120-row lookback leaves each symbol 0–5 rows. Lookback features are uncomputable, signals take their zero fallback, and the node fails "0 of 92 rebalance dates expressed a preference". That is 2 to 4 roots per 12-root campaign, each a charged trial. Nodes that do not fail are computed on a far shorter history than their code states.
bug.reproduction_steps: Build a MarketWindow with 40 symbols × 60 daily candles and call bars("1d", lookback=20). The frame has 20 rows, about 1 per symbol. Run EXAMPLE_SIGNAL_SOURCE against it: every score is 0.0, and normalize_scores refuses it.
bug.expected: - bars(freq, lookback=N) returns, for each symbol, that symbol's trailing N candles at or before t, ordered oldest-first by (symbol, open_time), as before. lookback=None still returns every candle the window carries. A symbol with fewer than N candles returns all of its own. Validation and the t-truncation are unchanged. - The docstring and its Parameters entry say "per symbol" explicitly. feature, borrow, bookfeat and trades are unchanged; the docstring notes that bars counts per symbol. - contract.CONTRACT_VERSION goes from "0.1.0" to "0.2.0", because the ABI's meaning changed. Tests that pin the literal contract version read contract.CONTRACT_VERSION instead, or move to "0.2.0". This covers the evaluator test files listed and orchestrator test_artifact_writer.py. No production code compares against a literal. - signal-agent _authoring.py: - the bars accessor's lookback_unit says "trailing candles per symbol of the requested freq; None reads every candle the window carries" - EXAMPLE_SIGNAL_SOURCE keeps lookback=20 (now per symbol) and stays a correct momentum example - Tests: - tests/contract/test_bars_lookback_per_symbol.py covers 40 symbols × 60 candles: each symbol gets exactly 20 rows; a symbol with 5 candles gets 5; lookback=0 gives an empty frame with the columns kept; None gives everything; t-truncation still holds; ordering is stable. - Existing tests/contract/test_market_window.py lookback tests are updated to the per-symbol rule, keeping their intent. - test_contract_declaration_detail.py's example test also runs the example over a 40-symbol × 30-day sealed snapshot, and its scores pass normalize_scores (they are not constant). All pass under pytest-xdist. The contract, signal-agent, evaluator and orchestrator member suites and the root tests/ suite pass.
bug.actual: Root cause: the bars accessor applies the shared rows-across-frame lookback discipline to a multi-symbol candle frame, where per-symbol is the only meaning a caller can use.
bug.constraints: Only bars' lookback semantics change; every other accessor is unchanged No file outside the sixteen listed is edited Do not edit docs/user-journeys/
